diagnosis: Customer with a Legacy Auth account is requesting instructions to reset their account-wide API token. Provide the standard reset steps and note the 24‑hour overlap period; no further internal action required.
reply: To reset your API token on a Legacy Auth account, sign in to the dashboard, go to the **Security** tab, and click **Reset token**. The existing token will continue to work for the next 24 hours, after which the new token becomes active. If you are unable to access the dashboard, we’ll need to verify your identity before making any credential changes.
